summary:
PASS 1 grind (2026-08-04): timeline/gantt chrome, legend, and per-row markers now match the prototype's own shapes (ring/diamond/bold-X/pulsing-dot/user+tool icon badges), the opening (and every) user turn renders as its own row, and every timeline/gantt/runs/tools row with a real target is click-through (jump-to-message or open-agent), verified end to end against the live backend. The runs tab is now RUNNING/COMPLETED(N)/FAILED grouped with real icons, a derived description, and a transcript action; the tools tab is rebuilt as the prototype's chronological call log (time, wrench, expandable name(argHint), agent tag, status glyph) sourced from real tool_call/tool_result parts, replacing the broken per-server catalog entirely (the blank-name wire bug is moot — and was also fixed at the source). The context tab's progress bar, 3-metric KPI grid, and 'live now' panel were already real (landed since this map was written) and are now re-verified. The window chrome gained a real bottom-right drag-to-resize grip. Two things remain genuinely unbacked and are NOT silently omitted: artifact rows/markers have no viewer to open anywhere in this app yet (tracked separately, 'mint real artifacts and ground the chips' / E7), and the context tab's 'live now' box is an honest in-session substitute for the prototype's cross-session feed, which has no backend surface.

PASS 2 grind (2026-08-05): re-verified all 18 items against the current tree (no observability code had moved since PASS 1's commit). Implemented the ONE item PASS 1 flagged as a real, closeable gap rather than a permanent unbacked one: the timeline's parent/child THREAD CONNECTOR brackets (hasOut/hasIn elbows joining a task-started row down to its own nested tool-call/sub-task rows, ~8244025). build.ts's threadHistoryTimeline() now walks the real chronological entries through an open/close stack keyed by the SAME handoffKey reconstructPartSpans already uses (delegate.started pushes, delegate.completed/background_exit pops by value — not always LIFO, so pop is a find-and-splice, not a blind pop), producing a real, provable nesting depth and an 'open'/'close' branch marker per row — replacing the wire's optional, frequently-absent `depth` field entirely. The renderer draws one continuing rail per open ancestor (index 0 always present, matching the prototype's own always-there L0) plus, on the exact row that opens or closes a level, an elbow bridging the last rail to the new/closing column — byte-for-byte the same geometry rule the prototype's own hand-authored demo array encodes (verified: a synthetic concurrent-siblings fixture mirroring the prototype's own 'analysis > gnss_timeseries_analysis + station_network_analysis' demo rows reproduces its exact depth sequence, unit-locked). Live-verified against the one live session with real expert_handoff nesting (sess_a7d05dfd2371, single-level sibling pairs — brackets render correctly, screenshot-judged) and against a real-CSS render of a synthetic 3-level-deep fixture (cascading brackets, tool markers nested at the correct depth) since no session on the shared live backend currently carries BOTH expert_handoff nesting AND tool_call children together to exercise multi-level depth end to end (noted as a live-data gap, not a code gap — the algorithm is unit-proven for that exact shape). Swept the same class of gap surface-wide: widened the log row's thread column (24px->70px, including the narrow-viewport override that had silently reverted it back to 24px) so depth up to ~4 never clips, and added missing :focus-visible rings on the tools tab's expand/agent-jump buttons. All other non-match items (pop-out button, artifact-row click-to-open, artifact-row navigation, context tab's 'live now' cross-session substitute) were re-verified unchanged: each already carries the project's visible-degraded pattern (disabled + data-unbacked + explanatory title) for a genuinely unbacked prototype behavior, correctly staying 'deviates' rather than 'match' since the prototype's OWN behavior differs, with the gap listed rather than silently absorbed.

PASS 3 grind (2026-08-05): re-verified all 18 items against the current tree (build.ts/types.ts/Observability.tsx/observability.css unchanged in shape since PASS 2's commit; re-confirmed live via curl against GET /v1/sessions/{id}/context/state — still no relay-latency/thinking-token field on the wire, and a repo-wide grep of the backend's gact routes confirms no cross-session "active runs" endpoint exists — so the two context-tab tiles and the LIVE NOW cross-session substitute stay correctly 'deviates', and DetailSlot.tsx is still reachable only from ShellPreview.tsx's own fixture harness, so the artifact-row-open gap stands). All four non-match items (pop-out button, artifact-row click-to-navigate, artifacts tab row click-to-open, context tab LIVE NOW) re-verified unchanged — each still correctly carries the visible-degraded pattern for a genuinely unbacked prototype behavior. Swept the same class of gap surface-wide and found ONE real, closeable miss: hovering the timeline log and gantt rows only lit up when the row also had a nav target (`.obs-log__row[data-nav='true']:hover` / `.obs-gantt__row[data-nav='true']:hover`), so the majority of rows on both views — 'routing_decision', 'main thinking + plan', 'task started', every non-jumpable gantt bar — gave no hover feedback at all. Measured against the LIVE prototype (not just its markup): its own row template carries `style-hover="background:var(--t-sf2,#1c1f25)"` unconditionally on every non-separator row in both `obsTl` (~8244025) and `ganttRows` (~8247351), entirely independent of `{{ r.cur }}`/`{{ g.cur }}` — verified with a real Playwright hover probe against the running prototype: a non-clickable row (cursor:default) and a clickable one both resolve to the identical computed background rgb(28,31,37) on hover, only the cursor differs. The app also used the generic `--t-hv` token where the prototype's own measured value is `--t-sf2` — the same class of drift already caught and fixed once before in rail.css ('rail hover tokens match the prototype's measured --t-sf2, not the generic --t-hv'). Fixed both selectors to hover unconditionally on `var(--t-sf2)`, leaving cursor:pointer and the focus-visible ring nav-gated (only real click targets are focusable/keyboard-actionable); live-verified with the same hover probe technique against the rebuilt app (non-nav and nav rows both now resolve to rgb(28,31,37) on hover, matching the prototype exactly) and failing-first unit-locked (observability-runs-tools-grind.test.tsx's 'PASS 3 — row hover highlight is unconditional' suite). The tools tab (`.obs-toollog__row:hover`) and runs tab (`.obs-run2__row:not(:disabled):hover`) already had this right and needed no change. No other gaps of this class found on this pass: legend glyphs are correctly non-interactive (prototype gives them no style-hover either), the artifacts tab's row-level hover is correctly suppressed while the feature stays globally unbacked (data-unbacked pattern), and narrow-viewport column compression (42.5rem breakpoint) already covers the thread column, artifact grid, run rows, and tool-log rows without new clipping.

items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/observability/Observability.tsx's LogNode() renders all six marker shapes (ring/diamond/bold-x/pulsing-dot/user-badge/tool-badge); PASS 2 adds ThreadRails() + build.ts's threadHistoryTimeline(), which threads every row through a real open/close stack keyed by the same handoffKey reconstructPartSpans already uses (delegate.started pushes, delegate.completed/background_exit pops by value) to compute a provable nesting `depth` and an 'open'/'close' `branch` marker (types.ts), replacing the wire's optional `depth` field entirely; observability.css's `.obs-log__rail`/`.obs-log__elbow` render one continuing rail per open ancestor (index 0 = the prototype's always-present L0/t-grad1, deeper indices = t-bd6, matching the prototype's own two-color scheme) plus an elbow at the exact row that opens/closes a level, which suppresses the plain marker on that row (matching the prototype's own isDot:false pairing on every hasOut/hasIn row); unit-locked (observability-build.test.tsx's 'timeline thread depth/branch' suite, including a synthetic fixture reproducing the prototype's own 'analysis > gnss + station spawned in parallel' concurrent-siblings demo rows depth-for-depth; observability-runs-tools-grind.test.tsx's 'timeline parent/child thread connectors' suite for the DOM shape) and live-verified against the one live session with real nesting (sess_a7d05dfd2371, screenshot-judged) plus a real-CSS render of a synthetic 3-level fixture (cascading brackets, tool markers at correct depth) since no session on the shared live backend currently carries tool_call children together with expert_handoff nesting to exercise multi-level depth end to end.

items.element: Timeline/gantt/runs/tools/artifacts row click-to-navigate (jump to message / open agent transcript / open artifact)
items.proto_truth: prototype's obsTl row builder (HTML offset ~8472858) wraps every row in a click handler keyed by row type: `r.jumpMsg` → closes the observability layer and scrolls the transcript to that message (title 'Go to message'); `r.isArt` → `this.artGo(r.name)` (title 'Open artifact'); rows naming a child agent → `this.goView(jk)` (title 'Open agent'); cursor is dynamically 'pointer' vs 'default' depending on whether a handler exists
items.app_evidence: Implemented and live-verified for 4 of 5 surfaces: (1) timeline user/tool_call rows carry a message-jump nav (build.ts, SessionView.tsx's handleObsNavigate scrolls `[data-message-id]` on Transcript.tsx's message article), (2) timeline expert_handoff/background_exit rows carry an open-agent nav when a real agent-task names the actor (build.ts's agentSessionLookup/agentNav), (3) gantt task-span rows carry the same open-agent nav (toTaskSpan), (4) runs tab rows open the run's child session on click. All four were exercised against the LIVE backend with real Playwright clicks: clicking a tools-tab row's agent tag closed the panel and scrolled the transcript to the exact tool-call message; clicking a completed run row switched the active session to that child's own transcript. Rows with no real target render inert (role/tabIndex/onClick only attached `{...navProps(nav, onNavigate)}` when `nav` exists) — matches the prototype's own cursor:pointer-vs-default rule. Unit-locked in observability-runs-tools-grind.test.tsx. PASS 3 also fixed a hover-highlight gap on the same rows (see summary): timeline log and gantt rows now hover-highlight on var(--t-sf2) unconditionally (matching the prototype's own row template), not only when a nav target exists — cursor and focus-visible stay nav-gated.
items.backend_surface: message ids (GET /v1/sessions/{id}/messages) and child_session_id (GET /v1/sessions/{id}/agent-tasks) are both real and already used

Wiring artifact-open here without that slice's own design would fork the eventual real implementation, so the artifacts row instead got the visible-degraded treatment (see the 'Artifacts tab row click-to-open' item below) rather than a half-real one-off. PASS 2: re-verified unchanged (DetailSlot.tsx is still reachable only from ShellPreview.tsx's own fixture harness). PASS 3: re-verified unchanged (same E7 gap; hover parity fixed separately, see summary).

items.element: Context tab: 'LIVE NOW · N' panel listing concurrently-running background jobs
items.proto_truth: proto-obs-context.png: a bordered box titled 'LIVE NOW · 3' followed by 3 orange-text rows, e.g. 'stripe-tuner · getstripe 6,143/9,800 · 12.4k tok ↑' and two rows prefixed with a lightning-bolt glyph ('⚡ io-monitor · sampling every 30s · last 08s ago')
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/observability/Observability.tsx's ContextTab renders a real 'live now · N' box (.obs-context__live) built from the SAME `runs` the runs tab shows, filtered to non-terminal state — this landed since the map was written and is re-verified live (apps/web/screenshots/side-by-side/obs-context-tab.png; also panels-conformance.test.tsx's dedicated live-now suite)
items.backend_surface: Session-scoped only (GET /v1/sessions/{id}/agent-tasks) — the prototype's own 'stripe-tuner'/'io-monitor'/'ior-sweep-04' rows are static demo copy, not computed from ANY session's real state either, so there is no existing backend concept of a cross-session 'everything running right now' feed to match against
items.fix_hint: Honest, real substitute already in place (this session's own non-terminal runs), not a fabrication — but it is not the SAME thing as the prototype's cross-session feed, hence 'deviates' rather than 'match'. A true fix needs a new session-agnostic 'active runs across all sessions' endpoint; out of scope for a single-session context/state read. PASS 2: re-verified unchanged. PASS 3: re-verified unchanged.
